episodes.title: The Whispering Wood
episodes.description: Scattered, the Ninja are lost in unknown realms! Lloyd and Arin find themselves in the mysterious Whispering Wood where they battle strange Elemental Monsters and encounter a protector of the forest who has a stunning revelation for Lloyd. Meanwhile, the young Ninja find themselves in a peaceful place... maybe too peaceful. Stuck in a distant cave, Jay opens up to Nya and Kai about his path ahead.

episodes.title: The Lean of a Tree
episodes.description: While in the Whispering Wood, Lloyd learns the secrets of the Green Ninja and why he may have missed his calling. Meanwhile, the young Ninja fall victim to the siren call of the mysterious land where they are stranded. And while Jay, Nya and Kai fight dangers outside this mysterious new Monastery, Jay determines that it's time he faces his forgotten past.

episodes.title: Tonight We Hunt Monsters
episodes.description: The young Ninja, desperate to get back home, must protect the bumbling explorers for the monster they are trying to catch. Nya and Kai aid in Jay's quest to unlock his memories, which leads them back to the Administration. The Whispering Wood is under siege, and the Loyalists search for the Weapon of Desolation!

episodes.title: A Wonder of the Merged Lands
episodes.description: Jay, Nya and Kai are on the threshold of restoring Jay's memories inside the Administration. In the Whispering Wood, Lloyd trusts his connection to guide him to the Temple of the Green Ninja. The others are doubtful until unexpected help arrives. Meanwhile, Sora, Frak, Wyldfyre and Riyu deal with the aftermath of the monster attack which draws them into conflict with the Explorer's Club.

episodes.title: Seed and Soil
episodes.description: Lloyd enters the Temple of the Green Ninja, but what he finds inside shocks him - maybe he won't survive the trial. Meanwhile, Sora, Frak and Wyldfyre are under attack in Umbrasylvis with their friend's life hanging in the balance. Back in Ninjago, the Loyalists draw closer to their goal and their leader is revealed.

episodes.title: Just Under the Surface
episodes.description: While escaping the Administration, Nya, Kai and Jay stumble onto a Loyalist plot. Meanwhile, Arin and the others defend the Whispering Wood while Lloyd completes his trial. Back in Ninjago, Cole investigates an attack in the city, and across the Merged Lands, Sora's team is held captive in Umbrasilvis until the masked stranger is found.

episodes.title: The Grand Inquisition
episodes.description: In order to clear their names and leave Umbrasylvis, Sora and Frak must unmask the Loyalist in the Explorer's Club ranks, but Frak's past clouds his judgment. Arin and the other Ninja tend to the Whispering Wood as its protector whithers - will Lloyd be too late? Inside the Temple of the Green Ninja, an unlikely guide helps Lloyd untangle his choices from his destiny.

episodes.title: Dying to Live
episodes.description: Cole finds himself in Loyalist headquarters with a clue to their ultimate goal. He attempts to single-handedly foil the plot with unexpected consequences for his Elemental Power. Meanwhile, Lloyd faces the ultimate test in the Temple of the Green Ninja, and the fate of the Whispering Wood and the entire Merged Lands hangs in the balance.

episodes.title: The Heartbeat of All Realms
episodes.description: The Loyalists march from Ninjago with the Weapon of Desolation in hand. Their leader raises an army of Elemental Monsters, and not even the Ninja, finally reunited, are a match for them. Meanwhile, Lloyd exits the Temple of the Green Ninja with new knowledge and powers, but his duty to the Whispering Wood might prevent him from saving the entire Merged Lands.

episodes.title: Birthright
episodes.description: The Loyalists and their Elemental Monster army take their battle into the streets, and the Ninja cannot combat the threat. A last minute ally delivers hope and turns the tide of battle - but will it be enough? Without the Source Dragons on their side, the Ninja must rely on each other to save the Merged Lands.
